behavior: New explicit harness namespace routes only help/caps/task submit/list/get/events/cancel to the same Host V1 API. Old task/run/cancel/goal/interactive V2 routes and old help JSON remain; one stderr help hint advertises the new namespace.
Submit requires opaque workspace ref, project, explicit stable request-id and bounded UTF8 stdin read exactly once; no model/provider/session config dependency, local executor, worker or task DB.
Existing resolver and current Host ID plus private session handoff/native bootstrap are reused. cliInitCredential is not called because its legacy env token override is forbidden for this namespace.
HTTP uses fixed relative routes, bearer from current Host only, no redirect/proxy or replayable POST body; request_id belongs to Core idempotency.
Lost submit ACK performs one exact original project/request-id GET lookup. FOUND is matched against original prompt/workspace/harness/scope. NOT_FOUND or mismatch remains UNKNOWN. No automatic POST.
Lost cancel ACK only reads exact task; it does not misuse submit request lookup. Conflict does not replace caller revision/Run/epoch or issue another mutation.
Cancel nullable queued fence and exact active Run/epoch/revision use canonical decimal strings including values above 2^53. ACKNOWLEDGED/CANCEL_REQUESTED are not labeled execution completed.

Compiles the exact embedded active rev2 contract with existing jsonschema/v6 (22 definitions, no external resources or runtime cwd schema). Adds strict int64 max, UTF8 byte and task/event/lookup association checks.

Stdout is one JSONL record, diagnostics are generic stderr. Known credential strings are removed structurally before JSON encoding; credential-bearing patterns are redacted. Invalid raw verbs are not echoed.
Ctrl-C before request is interruption/no send; cancellation after mutation may have reached Host remains UNKNOWN and never turns into a fake task cancel or replay.

safe_fixture_classification.no_program_entry_execution: Tests call runCLIHarness directly, never launch the ResearchOS or vendor CLI binary. main branch compatibility is additionally inspected as source; this is not claimed a real CLI execution qualification.
safe_fixture_classification.native: All Native/credential callbacks are private in-process fakes. No actual pipe, OS folder chooser, old session.json, auth/config/vault or secret file is opened in author checks.
safe_fixture_classification.http: Owned httptest loopback servers only for the actual disconnected POST/GET recovery and redirect denial controls; other requests use private fake RoundTripper. No external/model/provider requests.
safe_fixture_classification.storage: Only fresh test directories and non-secret source/inline-contract snapshots. No business DB or scheduler is created.
safe_fixture_classification.compatibility: Exactly five existing pure prompt tests, excluding executable entry, actual Native, provider/model, first-use DB and integration tests.

limits: Independent source QA pending. Formal/product acceptance increment is zero.
No actual CLI process or real Windows Native Host/model task was executed under this source lease; Root registers that separately after review/integration.
Credential native bootstrap is exercised through fakes and reuses the existing boundary; no stronger same-OS-user or HTTP-server authenticity claim is added.
Events read one page per command; no background follow/queue or client pending journal. Stable request IDs are mandatory for mutations.
Capabilities and requested platform policy are reported as Host facts; metadata is not promoted to model/filesystem/cancellation qualification.
Task histories and events remain authoritative in Core; CLI has no independent run state store.
